main.description: Create a postPrivate record in the writer's own repository. The record may name only one of the writer's own audience records; replying under another account's audience is participatePrivate. The host runs the record's text through its installed content codec before storing it.

repo.description: DID of the writer's repository. Must be the authenticated account.

rkey.description: Record key. A TID is generated when absent.

validate.description: Lexicon validation preference, as for com.atproto.repo.createRecord.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The record is malformed, or names an audience record outside the writer's repository.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may not write to this repository, or the host does not allow this account private-tier writes.

errors.name: UnsupportedNamespace
errors.description: The host does not have the private tier enabled.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: An embed references a blob the host does not hold.
